climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation covering the whole island of La Gomera, made up of six municipalities. Its rules allow still, sparkling, liqueur and overripe-grape wines from local grapes such as Listán Negro and Negramoll.
